common.skip_confirm_body: You can finish setup later from the menu bar icon.

welcome.title: Speak. Anywhere. Privately.
welcome.subtitle: Dictate into any app on your Mac. Everything runs on-device — no servers, no accounts.

accessibility.title: Grant Accessibility
accessibility.body: lda listens for your hotkey and types into the focused app. macOS requires Accessibility permission for both.

microphone.title: Microphone access
microphone.body: lda needs microphone access to capture your dictation. Audio is processed on-device and discarded after each transcription.
microphone.idle_hint: Click Test microphone, then say something.
microphone.hint_try_other: Not getting any sound. If your device is wireless (e.g. AirPods), it may not have switched to mic mode yet — try selecting a different input below.
microphone.hint_speak_louder: Picking up faint audio. Try speaking louder, or switch to a closer microphone.
microphone.tested_no_audio_hint: Try a different input device, or check your system volume.
microphone.tested_no_capture: Microphone did not produce any audio
microphone.tested_no_capture_hint: Open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone and make sure local-dictation-app is allowed, then try again.
microphone.tested_device_silent: Device opened, but is producing silence
microphone.tested_device_silent_hint: '{{device}}' may be muted, paused, or (if Bluetooth) stuck in output-only mode. Try selecting a different input below.
microphone.tested_tcc_blocked_hint: macOS didn't show the permission prompt. Open System Settings, allow local-dictation-app (or your terminal app, if running from cargo), then click Test microphone again.

models.title: Choose your models
models.body: Two models work together: one for transcription, one for cleanup. Both run locally.

hotkey.title: Choose your hotkey
hotkey.body: Hold this key while speaking. Release to dictate into the focused app.

general.force_pasteboard_helper: Skip Accessibility text injection; paste via clipboard instead.
general.launch_minimized_helper: Start without opening a window. The tray icon stays the only entry point until you click it. Combine with launch at login for a background-only experience.
general.stay_running_on_window_close_helper: Hide the window instead of quitting when you close it. The hotkey keeps working; reopen from the tray.
general.keep_models_warm_helper: Run a tiny warm-up inference after loading so the first dictation isn't delayed by Metal kernel compile + KV cache allocation.

models.delete_confirm_body: Removes the file ({{size}}) from disk. You can re-download it any time. If this model is currently selected, the path will be cleared and dictation will fall back to whatever's left.

home.title: Hold to dictate
home.ready_hint: Press and hold the key, then speak. Release to type into the focused app.
home.setup_incomplete_body: Complete the setup wizard to start dictating.
home.models_not_loaded_body: Open Settings to pick or download Whisper + LLM models.
